verdict.rationale: Gumloop offers two API key types (personal vs team/workspace-scoped) with the docs noting team keys are scoped to a single team, plus OAuth 2.0 for third-party app sign-in and per-agent Owner/User roles — showing some credential scoping mechanisms exist. However, both API key types are said to 'grant the same permissions and work on every endpoint,' indicating no fine-grained least-privilege scoping within a key, and there's no evidence of per-agent or per-tool scoped credentials, expiring tokens, or granular permission boundaries for agents specifically. missing for 10: fine-grained least-privilege scoping within API keys (permissions differ only by team vs personal, not by capability), documented ability to restrict an agent's credential to specific tools/actions, token expiration/rotation controls, independent confirmation of scoping enforcement.
